verdict.rationale: TrueLayer documents an official MCP server integration for Claude AI, exposing at least one concrete tool (create-truelayer-payment-link) that lets an agent perform banking/payment operations, and a probe confirms the doc page exists. Missing for 10: broader tool catalog beyond payment-link creation, independent/hands-on verification of the MCP server working, and details on setup/auth for non-Claude MCP clients.
